items.text: Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant in Wednesday’s practice, first full session since ankle injury.
items.why: First full practice since ankle sprain that sidelined him three games.
items.implication: Expected to play vs Bills; unlocks Ravens offense.
items.opportunity: Boosts targets/routes for WRs especially Flowers.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (limited) Wednesday after ankle.
items.implication: Tentatively projected to play vs Cowboys; monitor progression.
items.opportunity: Primary back role if full; Allgeier DNP competition.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant at Wednesday practice.
items.why: Shoulder issue; monitor rest of week.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 8 availability; high volume if plays.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Montgomery or others expand.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participant Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Track Thursday/Friday; elite usage if active.
items.opportunity: Jameson Williams routes up if sits.

items.text: Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest.
items.implication: Likely precautionary but monitor; WR1 volume if plays.

items.text: Time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield (Levitan/Silva).
items.why: Coleman return led snaps/carries; Payton wants more touches; Dobbins/Harvey efficiency down.
items.implication: Coleman waiver priority; reduces standalone of Dobbins/Harvey.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share expansion for Coleman; monitor DEN committee.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle suffered aggravation of previous chest injury; status vs Chiefs TBD based on practice.
items.why: Chest aggravation on reverse last week.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th yards/play with Huntley half snaps. Excited for Doyle/Lamar unlock.
items.why: Efficiency elite even without Lamar; full Lamar boosts.
items.implication: Flowers massive upside with Lamar return.

items.text: Prefer sell Chris Olave over Jordyn Tyson; rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Tyson unproven; Olave more established sell candidate.
items.implication: Trade Olave if possible; hold Tyson lottery.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could have big day vs Vikings defense pressuring Goff.
Eagles placed RB Dameon Pierce on IR; signed Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.why: Injury; third Eagles RB to IR.
items.implication: Thins Barkley handcuffs; Mitchell/Blue next up if Barkley limited.
items.opportunity: Barkley workload protected but no depth; monitor his hamstring/back DNP.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy lineup?
items.implication: Monitor snaps; flex consideration only if clear work.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, limited threats, shaded coverage.
items.implication: Continue starting confidently; WR1 upside holds.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Gibbs RB1 (clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4, LaPorta TE6, Goff QB2, Jameson WR24.
items.implication: Continue prioritizing Lions skill players ROS.
items.conflict: DNP statuses this week add short-term risk.
